name: AutoComplete
summary: Free-text input with suggestions as you type — search boxes, tag entry, known-but-open fields — rendered through the shared AutoComplete.
lead: AutoComplete carries a popup, live filtering and free-text-with-suggestions — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue). It renders on Ant's Select internals, so both wrappers theme once through the shared autocompleteTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

props.name: options
props.desc: Suggestions shown as the user types

props.name: onSearch
props.desc: Fires as the query changes — fetch/filter suggestions

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires when a suggestion is chosen

whenToUse.when: free text where suggestions help but the user may type their own value
the value MUST come from a known set — don't allow free text
free text with no suggestions to offer

opinion.note: Filter suggestions on the query, don't dump the whole list. AutoComplete allows values outside the options — if the value must be from the set, use Select instead.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared autocompleteTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (autocompleteTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 AutoComplete (Select internals) bound to autocompleteTheme.
